issues.description: The RISC-V set_prop implementation turns an absent PTE into a present entry, so the shared trait contract was weakened for one architecture instead of preserving its documented no-op behavior.
issues.rationale: The shared PageTableEntryTrait documents set_prop as a no-op for an absent entry, but this snapshot weakens that guarantee specifically on RISC-V. Its implementation unconditionally includes VALID in the new flags and writes them back without checking is_present, so an absent PTE becomes present. The review thread confirms the old implementation violated the documented behavior; the final PR head restores the architecture-independent no-op postcondition and adds the missing RISC-V guard. No runtime failure was claimed or reproduced.
